# Third-party baseline code snapshots

Reviewer-facing source snapshots for the external baselines discussed in the paper.

- [RL4DVRPTW](RL4DVRPTW/README.md): RL baseline implementations, shared simulator/utilities, source configs, and launch scripts.
- [GP-DVRPTW](GP-DVRPTW/README.md): GP baseline Python runner/simulator and supplementary Rust source.

Each directory has a `PROVENANCE.json` with the source commit and SHA-256 inventory. These are source snapshots; datasets, trained weights/checkpoints, and generated result artifacts are excluded. See each module README for the included scope and reproduction prerequisites.
